description: Calculates the payment for a loan based on constant payments and a constant interest rate.

params.description: The interest rate per period for the loan. For example, use 6%/4 for quarterly payments at 6% APR.
params.name: arg1

params.description: The total number of payments for the loan.
params.name: arg2

params.description: The present value: the total amount that a series of future payments is worth now.
params.name: arg3

params.description: The future value, or a cash balance which will be attained after the last payment is made. If omitted, it is equal to 0.
params.name: arg4

params.description: A logical value: payment at the beginning of the period = 1; payment at the end of the period = 0 or omitted.
params.name: arg5

signature: PMT(arg1: ApiRange | ApiName | number, arg2: ApiRange | ApiName | number, arg3: ApiRange | ApiName | number, arg4?: ApiRange | ApiName | number, arg5?: ApiRange | ApiName | number): number
